name: Half Cover
description: A target has half cover if an obstacle blocks at least half of its body, such as a low wall, large piece of furniture, or another creature.

name: Three-Quarters Cover
description: A target has three-quarters cover if about three-quarters of it is covered by an obstacle, such as a portcullis, arrow slit, or thick tree trunk.

name: Total Cover
description: A target with total cover cannot be targeted directly by an attack or spell. Completely concealed by an obstacle.
